summary.en: The exhibit sound: the swiss bed (marimba, woodblock, shaker) at 112–128 BPM by scene, a pencil rim for every ring, a stamp on the match cut, an impact and a chime on the measured gap.
summary.zh: exhibit 的声音：swiss 音乐床（马林巴、木鱼、沙锤），112–128 BPM，按场景分段；每个圈一声木边，匹配剪切一声戳，测量落定一声重击加钟声。

fits: Calm evidence films: tables, charts, reports.

intent.en: Paper and pencil: dry wood under small precise marks, so each ring is heard as a pencil touching the page.
intent.zh: 纸与铅笔：干燥的木质音色托着细小精确的标记，每个圈都像铅笔碰到纸面。

content.en: A film on the desk-survey arc; event kinds from the scenes’ plans.
content.zh: 按 desk-survey 骨架编排的片子；事件种类来自各场景的 plan。

fits.zh: 平静的证据类片子：表格、图表、报告。

notFor.zh: 炒热气氛的混剪；有旁白的片（改为压低）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
